learning_outcomes.text: Prepare students to apply for an internship in an English-speaking country
Prepare students for business life in an English-speaking country
Prepare students for life abroad, knowing how to integrate into the English-speaking world
Prepare students to achieve at least 785 on the TOEIC (grammar, vocabulary, listening, reading)

syllabus_topics: Enrichment of cultural knowledge of the English-speaking world
Describing their company and their responsibilities within the company
Numbers, figures, prices, measurements, alphabet, graphs, tables, etc.
Communication activities in varied contexts – professional, social, current events
Grammar revisions according to individual needs
Strategies and techniques for effective presentations in English
Cultural differences – working in the United States, Great Britain, Australia, etc.
bibliography: English Grammar in Use with answers - Raymond Murphy
Les Guides Officiels du Test TOEIC. Grammaire Vocabulaire du Test TOEIC - Hachette
degree: Diplôme d'ingénieur Centrale Nantes, spécialité Mécanique (apprentissage)
